summary: Tested ApplyScout landing page end-to-end. Backend (/api/signups, /api/preview, root) all pass pytest 4/4. Frontend desktop + mobile flows all pass: hero CTA scroll, nav CTA scroll, invalid+valid email capture (success block with position shown), job card approve/undo, truth demo fact toggles (sentences removed from draft and restored), FAQ accordion open/close, preview dialog full flow (sample -> analyzing -> results with 3 matches, match swap, edit textarea, approve shows 'Nothing was sent', close). Mobile 390x844 has no horizontal overflow, nav/FAQ/footer form reachable.
critical_code_review_comments: SignupResponse.position is derived from total signups count, so for a brand-new email the returned position equals the global count at that moment (OK for a waitlist number), but it is not stable per-user over time — if a seemingly-same user re-submits later, they will get a different (larger) position for the duplicate call than for the first call. In the tested same-request-pair scenario this is fine, but worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: Created a couple of signups prefixed with test_ for duplicate/success verification; all deleted after testing (signups collection cleaned).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py; run with pytest (JUnit output to /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml). Frontend uses data-testid everywhere; Lenis smooth-scroll requires ~1.5-2s wait after click. Preview dialog flow: hero-sample-btn -> preview-sample-btn -> preview-analyzing-step -> preview-results-step -> preview-match-{0..2} -> preview-edit-btn -> preview-draft-textarea -> preview-approve-btn -> preview-done-step -> preview-close-btn.
